geometry.fault_termination: columns end at the dike plane (depth = |offset| * tan(dip)) or at 4 km, whichever is shallower

reference_operator: observations and Green functions both pass through the block-space far-field plane projection (basis: constant, east, north; fit region beyond the far-field radius); model_farfield_plane_m is the fitted model's removed plane per dataset

lambda_selection.rule: smoothing weight reused from the primary fit (distributed_fit.json) so variants stay comparable

potency_partition.note: sum(fault area x slip) / sum(dike area x opening); not a moment-tensor ratio

east.interpretation: ridge and LOS-step evidence are consistent with a scarp

west.interpretation: ridge only; the LOS-step evidence is not consistent across geometries

notes: geometry fixed a priori; only dislocation magnitudes inverted
datasets normalized to co-event-through-18-July with the S1 decay summary
weights: per-dataset far-field robust sigma; offsets: per-dataset nuisance
regularization: Laplacian per surface, single lambda selected by minimum mean 10-km checkerboard held-out RMS for the primary fit
comparison with the 2005-2010 dike and fault geometries requires those exact geometry files
